source_access_note: Records without public links are not treated as missing; use the listed access route, Information Centre request pathway or reference source.
knowledge_base_maintenance: The master list is generated from the canonical data/*.json source files. v7.3 retains the v6.12 application structure while adding controlled knowledge-area/record-type metadata and curated regional records.
preview_note: Spatial Discovery uses the locally stored Trinidad and Tobago ADM1 GeoJSON as the canonical browser boundary asset. The optional media layer is off by default and does not change knowledge-record coverage counts.
news_note: EMA in the News uses 785 public-safe headline records covering 11 December 2025 to 24 July 2026. Archived clipping/OCR-only records and EMA-unit/manager mappings are excluded.
international_scope_note: The international collection remains restricted to Trinidad and Tobago-specific submissions, country/site/project records or country datasets. Broader Caribbean material is held in the separate regional collection.
video_note: The searchable video database ships with 32 verified records from v6.12 and can be expanded by the official EMA YouTube harvester using channel UCNijSNnsG3RHDWVC8-LIC8g. The harvester merges into videos.json rather than relying on an empty placeholder file.
deduplication_note: The same intellectual document is not duplicated solely because it appears in multiple repositories; alternate source or host links should be attached to the primary record where practical.
use_note: Descriptions, classifications, map associations, media categories and related-record suggestions support information discovery only and do not provide legal advice, legal interpretation, compliance status or an EMA determination.
